content.description: An oblique aerial view of a highway bridge pier standing in a shallow river. Scaffolding is attached to the pier cap beneath the deck.
content.alt_text: Aerial view of a concrete bridge pier with scaffolding in a river

photogrammetry.notes: Good overlap candidate; pier face is clearly textured.

summary: A drone orbits a highway bridge pier, then climbs to reveal the full span and the river beneath it.
activity: Aerial inspection orbit around bridge pier 2 followed by a climb.

scene_changes.change: Camera leaves the pier and rises to show the full span
View turns toward the river bank

timeline.what_happens: Drone circles pier 2 at close range, scaffolding visible.
Drone climbs and shows the full bridge span.
Camera pans across the river bank and vegetation.
